meta.name: landing-page
meta.description: Generate a complete, deployable landing page from a brief. Produces a single self-contained HTML file with Tailwind CSS (via CDN), responsive design, dark mode, semantic HTML, and OG meta tags. Sections: hero with CTA, features, social proof, pricing (optional), FAQ, footer. Use when building a marketing page, product launch page, coming soon page, or any standalone landing page. Triggers: 'landing page', 'create a page', 'marketing page', 'launch page', 'coming soon page', 'one-page site'.
